name: Solo · Stay a Little Longer
teacher: Ms. Brittany (weekly solo rehearsal; Hannah not available on a regular schedule)
rehearsal: Wednesdays 3:30–4:00 solo rehearsal with Ms. Brittany · Thu/Fri/Sun home practice
costume: Option 6 · Kellé Blossom Within — Leotard #5448A (lycra with ruched stretch-mesh wrap overlay, open crisscross back, organza flower appliqués you place yourself) + Draped Skirt #4518A (asymmetrical mesh, ruched front drape, longer back hem, attached lined trunks). Color: BLUSH for both. Leotard sized by girth; skirt by waist/hips.
music: Track is 2:04. Soft verse 0:00–0:48. Big swell at 0:48, full volume to 1:52. Fade 1:52–2:00, silent by 2:00. In the loud section a strong beat lands about every 2.3 seconds: finish every shape ON it.
map: ~0:11 drop to the floor & seated fold · ~0:15 side-sit leg reach (leg to the ceiling, arm traces it) · ~0:17 leg fans down, slide out long · ~0:34 attitude with arms up · ~0:50 cartwheel (right on the swell) · ~1:08 walkover/handstand · ~1:42 floor kick (donut roll comes after the walkover, calypso just before the scorpion and the ending — tap ＋ Cue here at the right moments) · ~1:50 passé turns · 1:53–2:03 floor ending — hold until the music is gone
strengths: Floor work is smooth, no crashing in or out
Full-body reach on the lunge (arms past the body)
Committed acro: cartwheel, walkover, handstand line is clean
Straight standing leg in attitude and passé
corrections: Point the foot and keep the knee straight on the side-sit leg reach (~0:15) and every floor extension, including on the way down.
Side extension: commit to a clean attitude or straighten it — no halfway
Eyes up: plan a focal point for every section, stop checking the mirror/Hannah
Passé: toe to the side of the knee, high relevé, sharp spot
Cartwheel prep should look like choreography, not a setup
#feet Donut roll: arms down, head ALL the way back — do not tuck the chin (Hannah)
Hold the final floor shape until 2:00 when the sound is fully gone
#knees Calypso: front leg straight and turned out, back knee high, land soft and keep moving
#timing Finish every shape ON the beat — count out loud, especially through the loud section
#feet Last leg lift before the ending: turn the leg out and point that foot hard (Hannah)
#knees First leg extension: take it all the way up before you open and fall (Hannah)
tricks: Side-sit leg reach (~0:15): sit on one hip, hand on the floor, leg straight up to the ceiling: 4 counts up, hold 2, 4 down, 6 each side. Arm slides up the leg, fingers past the toes. Cue: push the floor, reach the toe; knee stays straight as the leg fans down.
Side extension: développé side in 4 counts up, hold 2, 4 down, at a counter — 6 each side. Side-lying leg lifts 2×12. Decide with Ms. Brittany: clean attitude or straight leg.

Cartwheel on the swell: drill the 4 counts before it as dancing — reach, look, place. Head stays up until the hands go down. Legs pass through vertical along a floor line. Land with the arm finish on the beat.
Walkover/handstand line: belly-to-wall handstand 3×10–15s, kick-ups to vertical with straight legs, split shape at the top. Wrists warmed up first. Kick-overs only with a spotter until cleared.
Floor kick: kick from the hip not the back; 8 slow kicks each side with a pointed foot at the top; hamstring stretch after.
Passé turns: passé balance on relevé 10s; quarter turns, then half, then single; spot a sticker on the wall; arms round like holding a beach ball.
The ending: play the last 15 seconds of the real track 5 times and hold the shape, breathing, until it is silent. Count 8 more after you think it is over.

Donut roll (after the walkover and the extension): warm the back first (cobra, then seal). Kneeling backbend with hands to heels 3×5s. Bridge holds 3×10s. Then the donut shape: arms down, knees bent, chest open, head ALL the way back — Hannah's fix is not to tuck the chin. Practise on the mat, the way she set it. Cue: lead with the chest, eyes follow the feet.

Calypso: the entrance is step, prepare, chaîné, calypso — drill those four words out loud. Kick the front leg straight and turned out as you turn, back knee up and bent, chest lifted — 6 each way, then 4 to the music. Land softly and roll straight out of it, then stand all the way up.

Front walkover to knee: belly-to-wall handstand 3×10s first. Walkover on the mat reaching long, legs split at the top; slow the second leg and lower to the knee with a tall chest — 5 with a spotter or as cleared by the teacher. The landing knee touches softly, never drops.

Scorpion to needle: warm the back first (cobra, seal, 3×10s). At the barre or counter: hold a low scorpion 3×8s each side with hips square and the standing knee straight, then tilt forward toward needle only as far as it stays easy. Never pull past today's range; stop if the back pinches.

cues.move: Opening walk — eyes to the back row
Drop to the floor & seated fold
Side-sit leg reach — leg to the ceiling, arm traces it
Leg fans down, slide out long
Rolls down to the elbow — big arch
The swell — dance the 4 counts in, go BIG

story: Someone you love is packing to leave. Ask them to stay one more minute.
performance: Character: she is alone, fighting to keep someone from walking away. Every reach is a plea.
Face — pleading & yearning: look past the judges with soft, open eyes and slightly parted lips, reaching for someone just out of touch.
Face — fragility: on the quiet lines let the breath drop, soften the brow, let the focus fall to the hands.
Musicality — rushing vs suspended: sharp, urgent movement for panic, then slow suspended floats to stop time.
Musicality — chorus swells (0:48 on): biggest extensions across the whole stage when the vocal opens up.
Stage presence: eye line all the way to the top back rows. Breathe audibly with the music on every jump and floor descent.
Secret: every time an arm reaches out, the fingertips hold an invisible thread tied to the person you love — pull so they won't slip away.
steps: Start looking down
Counts 1 & 2, shoulder on 3, then 4, 5
Reach, reach — click, click
Roll ×4, down onto the elbow
Nose to knee, then look up
Take: arm, head, come in, pick it up
Big arch — attitude kick — roll
Right to the bum and arch up
Touch the knees, run backwards
Reach left, right — first position — coupé
Leg extension all the way up — open, fall
Relevé, run to the corner
Chassé leap, then handstand
Arm, arm, sharp — throw it — big jump — chassé the other way
Reach — hands over the face — throw
Back out into the walkover — freeze, bend it, arch up (breathe)
Extension
Donut roll: arms down, head all the way back
Passé reach, then the other passé
Rond de jambe ×3, big reach
Tilt extension — bend it and fall
Come up and spin
Fall — right leg on top, go that way
Split — arch — come in
Sharp, turn — right leg high — come in
Step, prepare, chaîné, calypso — roll — stand all the way up
Scorpion, then melt
Right leg up: turned out, foot pointed hard
Plié and bend slowly down — fall asleep, hold

Show Ms. Brittany a run with no missed steps
Tricks start (the whole dance is from memory first)
